decision_conditions: Insufficient and inadequate information has been submitted to be able to discharge condition number 6 (SuDS).  As applications for details reserved by conditions cannot be part discharged, condition 3 (materials) and condition number 4 (landscaping) is also not discharged.  The details submitted do not comply with policy CP21 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), policy SI 13 of the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/03604/FUL for materials (3), landscaping (4) and sustainable drainage (6) in respect of the extension to hospital to create Urgent Treatment Centre [UTC], associated alterations, landscaping and demolition of existing cabin.
